title: 探针泛化作为子空间选择：用于OOD欺骗检测
summary: 研究发现，线性探针在分布外（OOD）欺骗检测中泛化失败，但将输入投影到训练激活的主成分（PC）子集上可实现跨域迁移，接近直接训练的性能。利用LLM对PC评分选择可迁移方向，可显著缩小基线到最优的差距，表明OOD鲁棒性主要由子空间选择决定。
summary_en: Linear probes fail to generalize OOD in deception detection, but projecting onto a subset of principal components from training activations enables cross-domain transfer nearly matching oracle performance. LLM-scored PC selection closes 78%/25% of the gap, suggesting OOD robustness is largely determined by subspace selection.
